references.text: The tribe of Manasseh is mentioned as one of the tribes descended from Joseph's sons, showing the tribe's origin and place among the tribes of Israel.
Manasseh was Joseph's firstborn son, born in Egypt. This explains the connection between Joseph and the tribe of Manasseh.
Jacob adopted Ephraim and Manasseh as his own sons, giving them status as separate tribes in Israel.
The descendants of Manasseh are counted in the second census, showing the tribe's continued existence.
The tribe of Manasseh received its inheritance in the promised land, which the spies from this tribe helped to explore.
